description: The unknowns plugin, served from its own repository — one command to add, one to install, always at the version this repository declares.

plugins.name: unknowns
plugins.description: Know your unknowns — skills for the gap between your plan and the actual situation, in any domain: what you don't know, what the AI doesn't, and what neither knows yet. Eleven skills: blind-spot passes, field primers, interviews, divergent prototypes, brainstorming, reference read-backs, tweakable plans, a deviation log, buy-in docs and quizzes — plus two Claude Code agents.
